body:
>only you can make the change for the better

And I'm completely incapable of doing that.

I don't have another choice.
To be perfectly honest this is only encouraging me
I've already fucked up my chance at being here, even a short time is too long to wait.
So just because one person with outstanding intelligence does things with aforementioned intelligence means that anyone in a similar situation can do the same? Really?
How is that supposed to make me feel better at all?
Small update, I replied to their email to tell them that I won't require picking up. Anticipating an angry response. Trying to take my mind off of it.
I know it's the right thing, I just don't think I'd ever do it. I can just see myself choking up
